name: Franco's Flapjack
notes: Franco's Flapjack is a small local chain (Bonita, Poway, Alpine, and this Chula Vista/Broadway-and-Moss location). Yelp confirms the exact address (1037 Broadway, Chula Vista) under the plain name 'Franco's Flapjack'. Instagram says 'Order through DoorDash', but every DoorDash/order.online listing found (searched by name and via site:doordash.com) resolves only to the Bonita (4164 Bonita Rd) and Poway (14034 Poway Rd) branches - no store page found for the Chula Vista branch itself.
blocked: no priced source found for this specific branch (1037 Broadway, Chula Vista); DoorDash only surfaces the chain's Bonita and Poway locations

name: Madina Market Halal Fast Food
notes: Batch website halalchickenusa.com is NOT this restaurant's own site - it is a nationwide halal-chicken directory/aggregator ('HALAL CHICKEN USA...tracking 1,500+ locations'), so no first-party site exists. DoorDash store address matches exactly (3890 50th Street, San Diego). DoorDash's own MenuBookCategory metadata reports exactly 1 category / 12 items, matching what was extracted, so this is the complete DoorDash catalog (not a truncated read) even though all items fall in one 'Special Food Menu' section - consistent with this being primarily a halal market/butcher counter with a small hot-food menu.

name: Mimi’s Panini Italian Deli
notes: Restaurant's own site (mimispanini.com) is a client-rendered Wix page with only hours/address, no menu content reachable via curl. Uber Eats store address matches batch exactly (1237 Prospect St, La Jolla). Prices cross-check against Yelp popular-dish snippets seen in search (Prosciutto Di Parma $17.00, Mortazza $16.00, Godfather $18.00) - all match. 28 items across 7 sections (The Classic, Panini, Pressed Panini, Build Your Own, Dolce, Drinks, Deli Case), plausible for a small deli.

name: Mood ALsham restaurant
notes: An Instagram reel for 'Mal Al Sham' gives the address '478 W Douglas Avenue, El Cajon, CA 92020' - matching the batch address exactly - so this is confirmed to be a branch of the Mal Al Sham Syrian-restaurant chain, apparently the successor to 'Uncle Feras Resturant' at the same address. However all priced sources found (malalsham.com, Grubhub, Uber Eats, DoorDash 'Abn al Sham') are for OTHER branches at different addresses (388 E Main St and 8575 Los Coches Rd, El Cajon) - no ordering page or priced menu found specifically for the 478 W Douglas Ave location.
blocked: no priced source found for this specific branch (478 W Douglas Ave, El Cajon); menus found online belong to other branches of the same chain at different addresses

name: Get Baked Cookie Co.
notes: Own site (getbakedcc.com) is fully client-rendered, no static content. Per its own Instagram bio and a home-bakery marketplace listing (thefrontporch.store), this is a cottage-food operation baked in a home kitchen, sold only at the Vista farmers market (Saturdays) and pop-ups - no fixed storefront (batch address is null), no delivery-platform presence, no prices found anywhere.
blocked: cottage-food/home-kitchen seller with no storefront; no priced source found anywhere (site is client-rendered, sells only at farmers-market pop-ups)

name: Tierra y Mar
notes: First-party PDF menu (dated July 2026) linked directly from the restaurant's own page on harrahssocal.com, Harrah's SoCal casino resort's website; this is a full-service themed restaurant (site tags it 'restaurant' type, distinct from the property's 'bar' and 'grab-and-go' locations), not a concession stand.
